title: Unified Multimodal Uncertain Inference
abstract: arXiv:2604.08701v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce Unified Multimodal Uncertain Inference (UMUI), a multimodal inference task spanning text, audio, and video, where models must produce calibrated probability estimates of hypotheses conditioned on a premise in any modality or combination. While uncertain inference has been explored in text, extension to other modalities has been limited to single-modality binary entailment judgments, leaving no framework for fine-grained probabilistic reasoning in or across other modalities. To address this, we curate a human-annotated evaluation set with scalar probability judgments across audio, visual, and audiovisual settings, and additionally evaluate on existing text and audio benchmarks. We introduce CLUE (Calibrated Latent Uncertainty Estimation), which combines self-consistent teacher calibration and distribution-based confidence probing to produce calibrated predictions. translated_title: 统一多模态不确定性推理
translated_abstract: 我们提出了统一多模态不确定性推理（UMUI），这是一个跨越文本、音频和视频的多模态推理任务，要求模型基于任意模态或模态组合中的前提，对假设产生经过校准的概率估计。尽管不确定性推理已在文本领域得到探索，但向其他模态的扩展一直局限于单模态的二分类蕴含判断，尚无框架支持在其他模态内部或跨模态进行细粒度的概率推理。为解决这一问题，我们构建了一个由人工标注的评估集，涵盖音频、视觉和视听场景下的标量概率判断，并在现有的文本和音频基准数据集上进行了额外评估。我们提出了CLUE（校准潜在不确定性估计），该方法结合了自洽的教师校准和基于分布的置信度探测，以产生经过校准的预测。我们证明，我们30亿参数规模的模型取得了……
tldr: 该论文提出了跨越文本、音频和视频的统一多模态不确定性推理任务UMUI，并设计了结合自洽教师校准与分布置信度探测的CLUE方法，实现了跨模态的细粒度校准概率估计。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces UMUI, a unified multimodal uncertain inference task spanning text, audio, and video, and proposes CLUE, which combines self-consistent teacher calibration and distribution-based confidence probing to enable fine-grained calibrated probabilistic reasoning across modalities.
